review_description: I had a very wide range of prices from $2500 to $8000 all for a 1.5kw system  I ended up going with Metro as they had a 1.5 kw system with a 2 kw inverter which give me the ability to grow the system at a later date they quoted me $2995 including travel to install which will be the 17th January 2011

The system hasn't been installed yet , due to the Christmas break. It is to be installed early in the new year, so it is too early to comment on effectiveness.The system is 1.5 Kw with a 2.0 Kw inverter, which gives us the option of adding another two panels, at a later date if we desire.
